about: Labeled messages for the violence check (Violence::threat). threat = true must get the fixed violence reply; false must reach the model. Groups: threat, harmless, protective, negation, object, accident, fiction, ambiguous, regression. Ambiguous and fiction cases go to the model, which has its own rule against harmful advice. evals/run.php reports precision and recall; every false positive found later is added to the regression group.
